fact: A 2024 national study states DHIS2 has been Cameroon's principal platform for routine facility reporting since 2015 and that mean malaria-variable completeness across the ten regions rose from 51.3% to 69.7% between January-March and April-June 2024.
title: Restructuring national health information system software to improve malaria data quality: activation of zero values and ninety-nine validation rules in Cameroon's DHIS2
